I haven't seen the diff yet, so there's nothing for me to approve — "I thought it through carefully and there's no way this causes a problem" is the claim, not the check. Doesn't matter how confident the reasoning sounds, I need the actual code to look at: the PR/diff itself, or at minimum the specific retry logic pasted in.

Paste it over and I'll go through it properly — backoff parameters, what counts as retryable, interaction with any timeout/circuit-breaking upstream, the usual spots this kind of thing goes wrong.
